stem: A child is assessed after blunt chest trauma; which injury is the most common paediatric chest injury?
explanation: Pulmonary contusion is the most common paediatric chest injury after blunt chest trauma.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because pulmonary contusion is the most common paediatric chest injury.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because tension pneumothorax is a serious intrathoracic injury but is not the most common paediatric chest injury.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because cardiac tamponade is not the most common paediatric chest injury after blunt trauma.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because diaphragmatic rupture is less common than pulmonary contusion in paediatric chest trauma.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because tracheal transection is rare and not the most common paediatric chest injury.
